findings.reason: the honest change retires (or privatises) the renderer and has the reset bind through build_path_prefix_filter, leaving one public prefix-clause API instead of two.
findings.text: after §24 moves the five path claims in imas_codex/discovery/paths/parallel.py (484,540,597,715,795) onto build_path_prefix_filter, render_path_prefix_clause retains exactly one external caller, the reset at imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py:108, which binds params["path_prefixes"] by hand at reset.py:136 while build_path_prefix_filter already returns clause+params; §24's stated reason for keeping the renderer ("each binds once and is pinned by its own tests") no longer distinguishes it

findings.reason: two implementations of one exclusion rule drift silently (claims and scans can disagree about what is excluded); the plan should add an agreement test or derive both from one predicate.
findings.text: the path-prefix exclusion rule is implemented twice: Python should_exclude matches prefixes with path.startswith (discovery_config.py:156) at seed/scan time, and the §24 helper re-expresses the same rule as a Cypher STARTS WITH predicate at claim time; the section's claim that "the policy has one owner" names only the configuration, and no test is named that shows the two agree

findings.reason: reading facility configuration from the pure graph query-builder inverts the layering to hold one function; place the facility-exclusion predicate in the discovery/config layer that owns the policy, leaving query_builder a pure renderer.
findings.text: §24 places the new config-reading exclusion helper in imas_codex/graph/query_builder.py, which today imports only imas_codex.graph.schema_context_data and imas_codex.graph.vector_search and has no dependency on imas_codex.config (no graph/*.py imports imas_codex.config); the exclusion policy owner is get_exclusion_config_for_facility in imas_codex/config/discovery_config.py:506

duplicate_owner-1.reason: Settled in the claims node's done-when rather than another plan round: its test asserts that for a set of sample paths the claim predicate excludes exactly the paths should_exclude marks by path prefix, which is the agreement check between the Python and Cypher forms.

duplicate_owner-2.reason: Settled in the claims node's done-when: the facility-reading exclusion helper is placed in imas_codex/config/discovery_config.py beside get_exclusion_config_for_facility, and query_builder keeps only the pure build_path_prefix_filter it calls; no layering inversion lands.

thin_wrapper-1.reason: Retiring render_path_prefix_clause and moving the reset onto build_path_prefix_filter is a refactor that does not change exclusion correctness; the reset binds its one parameter once and is pinned by its tests. Deferred.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the added behaviour is one facility-exclusion predicate helper (config resolution + negation + parameter naming + clause/params) alongside the existing clause+params builder, not a spread of shallow per-call wrappers; the 22 call sites stay one-liners.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §24 creates a second implementation of the path-prefix exclusion rule (Cypher STARTS WITH) beside the existing Python one (should_exclude) for the same ExclusionConfig.path_prefixes, with no agreement test, and places the new predicate in imas_codex/graph/query_builder.py rather than with its owner imas_codex/config/discovery_config.py.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §24 accounts for its surface in its own text (one new public helper plus a widened build_path_prefix_filter signature, with the reason it cannot fold: "that builder must stay a pure function of an alias and a list, while the exclusion helper reads the facility's configuration"), and no section adds a CLI option, MCP view or refusal family.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan cites existing machinery by file:line and extends it rather than forking: build_path_prefix_filter and render_path_prefix_clause in imas_codex/graph/query_builder.py, should_exclude and get_exclusion_config_for_facility in imas_codex/config/discovery_config.py, reset_to_status in imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py, and create_nodes in imas_codex/graph/client.py; §14 retires seed_missing_roots and deletes create_child_paths, and §24's census of 22 claim/has-work sites matches the tree exactly (paths/parallel.py 465,521,579,688,767,197,265,282,301,318,338; code/graph_ops.py 95,277,367,457,566,611,636,660,692,726; code/workers.py 564).
